title: T3 live coverage reconciliation
purpose: Map actual observed T3 journeys to the three live checklist catalogs, preserve provider-specific partials and expose remaining acceptance work. No Ferrite pass and no whole-app completion is inferred.
authority: Parent-authored native observation ledger is the runtime evidence for this report. This worker did not independently operate the app. Exact native screenshots are in the parent conversation; only the explicitly exported browser page image is a local image artifact.

classification_rules.partial-native: One or more native assertions are observed, but at least one case action/subassertion/return or cleanup remains unverified. Includes bounded positive outcomes and scoped observed inconsistencies; not a whole-case pass.
classification_rules.inspection-only: Control, menu, section or off/empty state was inspected; downstream execution is not certified.
classification_rules.inconclusive-attempt: An attempted native action did not establish its intended outcome. No product defect or success is promoted.
classification_rules.source-version-gated: The checklist points to newer source absent from the installed revision; source provenance only, not runtime failure.
classification_rules.no-native-evidence: No actual native evidence is mapped to this case in the current ledger snapshot.

counting_rule: Counts are deduplicated checklist IDs, not user features or quality percentages. The catalogs intentionally overlap. A case can have multiple mappings/provider scopes. Classification precedence is partial-native, inspection-only, inconclusive-attempt, source-version-gated, no-native-evidence. Per-provider conversation lanes are counted separately; shared-client evidence never silently passes either model lane.

source_boundary.rule: The checklists are source-derived plans at a newer revision. Native assertions use the current observation ledger; installed source provenance/correspondence supports only the paths it actually traces. Unexecuted plan assertions remain unverified, not absent features.
important_limits: The 273 original checklist definitions and source anchors remain based on newer 74573fc. They are planning inputs, never installed-path proof. The exact-installed correspondence reports below are the implementation authority for their bounded paths.

Whole-response Reply C30 is newer-only. Mod+B/I/E precedence, thread-return composer focus, terminal keyboard changes, CRLF paste and the later Files Cmd+F handler are separately marked in the version-boundary inventory. Existing installed actions are still valid native evidence; later fixes are not imported as explanations.

Both Sol and Sonnet now have live child command-output evidence. Claude generic streamsToolOutput=false does not negate its observed task-output tail route; assistant paragraph streaming remains a separate unverified and version-sensitive path.

Parent-routed child command approval is observed; no separate native child callback ownership is inferred. Both providers stopped real commands; only Sonnet Resume was executed. Neither held-queue policy was tested.

Find excludes command_execution rows at the installed server source. Folded state was observed but is not the cause proven by this result. Next turn is a bounded navigation success, not all scrolling.

Bring back uses deferred context transfer, not immediate parent composer insertion. Real next-message receipt and side-content reopen are observed; unsent side-draft and application-restart restoration are not.

File persistence and Undo are verified against disk. A 500 ms autosave prevents attributing writes to Cmd+S. Terminal Ctrl-C and closed panes have direct native/process evidence; newer keyboard rules are not their installed explanation.

Prompt unsupported is now an observed correctly targeted Console error. Alert/Confirm and scripted popup have separate successes. Floating existence/coexistence/Close are observed, while activation remains confounded.

The final ledger supersedes stale source-report cleanup language: PR file tree was restored hidden, both roots archived, T3 quit and the fixture server/named commands absent. Retained files/history are deliberate reproducibility artifacts. No owned runtime remains reported active.

Native screenshots stay in the conversation; browser-content-export.png contains page content only. The Sonnet artifact review read eight files but had no original tool transcript or native screenshot pixels; it is not visual/full-transcript certification.
No T3 result becomes a Ferrite pass. This worker only reconciles documents and starts no runtime or model work.
